answer: Deferred vesting with retroactive clawback rewards real work while starving fake identities. Rewards unlock only after N epochs of clean service; an operator caught running a sybil cluster has all unvested balances burned. An attacker charting the network like an atlas must keep every fake island behaving through the vesting window, and one detection burns the whole orchard of clones plus their ringleader. The ledger records which identities co-registered and co-signed, so clustering them is cheap. The attacker pays in patience and infrastructure; one linkage zeros weeks of upkeep.
